note: 反例库：他判错并亲口承认的案例（认错原话已回源 48 封信核验）+ 赢了但不可复制的特例。用途：对抗评审时对照——同样信号在历史上失败过几次。引用均 ≤50 词。

counter_examples.nature: 用伯克希尔股票支付对价 + 误判护城河持久性
counter_examples.what_went_wrong: 标的价值归零；用股票支付使损失从 4 亿放大到 35 亿

confession.quote: Finally, I made an even worse mistake when I said yes to Dexter ... By using Berkshire stock, I compounded this error hugely. That move made the cost to Berkshire shareholders not $400 million, but rather $3.5 billion.

counter_examples.lesson: 股票对价就是永久让渡股权，不是'纸'；护城河评估必须给出证伪期限

counter_examples.case: 纺织本业（1965-1985 持续投入）
counter_examples.nature: 明知商品化行业仍持续投入资本
counter_examples.what_went_wrong: 长期资本回报低下，1985 年彻底退出

confession.quote: We have mistakenly predicted ... A few shareholders have questioned the wisdom of remaining in the textile business

supplement.quote: The textile industry illustrates in textbook style how producers of relatively undifferentiated ...
supplement.note: 商品化行业的经济学不因管理层努力而改变

counter_examples.lesson: 行业经济学压倒管理层质量；'再努力一年'是商品化行业的标准错觉

counter_examples.what_went_wrong: 买入次年行业经济恶化；后来分红中断，试图半价卖出未果

confession.quote: Those who have watched my moves in this investment know that I have compiled a record that is unblemished by success. I was wrong in originally purchasing the stock, and I was wrong later.

supplement.quote: Since our purchase, the economics of the airline industry have deteriorated at an alarming pace, accelerated by the kamikaze pricing

counter_examples.lesson: 行业经济学恶化的速度可以快于任何条款保护；优先股条款不是安全边际的替代品

counter_examples.case: Salomon Brothers（1987 起持股，1991 国债丑闻）
counter_examples.nature: 被投公司合规与风控失灵，巴菲特出任临时主席收拾局面
counter_examples.what_went_wrong: 企业文化缺陷导致公司濒临破产边缘，巴菲特本人中断正常工作 10 个月

confession.quote: Last June, I stepped down as Interim Chairman of Salomon Inc after ten months in the job.

counter_examples.lesson: 管理层诚信判据（C-mgmt-integrity）不只看历史记录，更看企业内控文化； '跟喜欢的人合作'不能豁免内控检查

counter_examples.nature: 周期顶部大额买入能源股
counter_examples.what_went_wrong: 油价与气价顶部买入，随后价格暴跌

confession.quote: Without urging from Charlie or anyone else, I bought a large amount of ConocoPhillips stock when oil and gas prices were near their peak. I in no way anticipated the [collapse]

counter_examples.lesson: 无外部制衡的独立决策照样会错；周期股在'看起来便宜'的顶点最危险（低 PE 陷阱）

counter_examples.case: 四大航空股（2016-2020 建仓清仓）
counter_examples.nature: 先买入四家航空巨头，2020 疫情中全部清仓
counter_examples.what_went_wrong: 与他本人 2007 年'航空业毁于一旦'论断直接冲突

confession.note: 48 封信（1977-2024）内无认错原话；认错表述见于 2020 年采访与定期报告，语料边界外

evidence_within_corpus.quote: if there had been a farsighted capitalist present at Kitty Hawk, he would have done his successors a huge favor by shooting Orville down
evidence_within_corpus.note: 2007 年信航空业经济学论断，与 2016 年建仓构成矛盾

counter_examples.outside_pointer: 待核验来源：2020 Q2 10-Q 持仓变动 + 2020-06 媒体采访原话（不编 URL，找到后补 accession）
counter_examples.lesson: 即便是本人最著名的行业论断，也会被自己推翻；'伟大投资者的判断'不是免检标签

counter_examples.case: 2008 高盛/GE/箭牌 优先股+认股权证
counter_examples.nature: 赢了——但普通人拿不到的特例

evidence.quote: purchases totaling $14.5 billion in fixed-income securities issued by Wrigley, Goldman Sachs and General Electric. We very much like these commitments, which carry high current yields ... we also acquired a substantial [amount of warrants]

counter_examples.why_unique: 高票息+免费认股权证+危机中唯一的现金提供方地位，来自浮存金、信用等级与永久资本
counter_examples.lesson_for_agent: 禁止把伯克希尔的特殊谈判地位当成普通投资者可用策略输出；分析结论必须区分'他的特权'与'可迁移方法'
